## Survival Guide
Here you will find all the necessary information about surviving in the Wasteland.
Your Pip-Boy and tactical maps mark active expedition entrances on the displayed world map. Use these markers to find the authored factory and cave expeditions. Entrances on a different map are not shown.
## Guide Sections
[bold]Survival Basics[/bold]
Contents: Food, water, radiation management, and weather protection. The fundamentals every Wasteland survivor needs to know.
